name: TagInput
description: The TagInput component provides an interactive, accessible way to select and create tags from a predefined list of options.
usage: Use TagInput when users need to select multiple tags from a predefined list
Allow users to create new tags by providing the onCreateTag handler
Display validation errors with the error prop (respects touched state)
Limit the number of tags that can be selected using maxTags prop
Use keyboard shortcuts: Enter key to add tags without form submission
Tag suggestions show up to 5 relevant suggestions as you type
Helper text is displayed below the input (not shown when error is displayed)
Use touched prop to control when errors are shown (e.g., only after user interaction)
examples:
<TagInput
  id="skills"
  label="Skills"
  availableTags={availableSkills}
  selectedTags={selectedSkills}
  onChange={setSelectedSkills}
  onCreateTag={async (tagName) => {
    // API call to create a new tag
    const response = await fetch('/api/skills', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ name: tagName }),
    });
    const newSkill = await response.json();
    return newSkill; // Should return { id: string, name: string }
  }}
  helperText="Select skills or create new ones by typing and pressing Enter"
/>

<TagInput
  id="topics"
  label="Topics"
  availableTags={availableTopics}
  selectedTags={selectedTopics}
  onChange={setSelectedTopics}
  error="At least one topic is required"
  touched={hasSubmitted}
  required
/>

<TagInput
  id="keywords"
  label="Keywords"
  availableTags={availableKeywords}
  selectedTags={selectedKeywords}
  onChange={setSelectedKeywords}
  maxTags={5}
  helperText="Select up to 5 keywords"
/>
design: Focus states provide visual indication when the input is focused with border and ring styling
Error states display with red border and error message
Loading state shows spinner with 'Loading tags...' message
Tag suggestions are limited to 5 items to prevent overwhelming the user
Selected tags display with Tag component and remove button (X icon)
Create new tag button appears when onCreateTag handler is provided and input doesn't match existing tags
Maximum tags limit visually prevents adding more tags and hides input when reached
accessibility: Proper labeling with associated IDs using htmlFor attribute
Error messages are properly associated with the input
Interactive elements have appropriate roles and focus states
Remove tag buttons have aria-label describing the action
Required fields indicated with visual asterisk and required prop

props.name: id
props.description: Unique identifier for the input (required for accessibility)

props.name: label
props.description: Text label displayed above the input

props.name: availableTags
props.description: Array of all available tags. TagOption interface: { id: string; name: string; }

props.name: loading
props.description: Whether the tags are currently being loaded

props.name: onCreateTag
props.description: Optional function to handle creating new tags

props.name: error
props.description: Error message to display when validation fails (only shown when touched is true)

props.name: touched
props.description: Whether the field has been touched/interacted with (controls error visibility)

props.name: helperText
props.description: Helper text displayed below the input (not shown when error is displayed)

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS class for the container element

props.name: required
props.description: Indicates if the field is required

props.name: maxTags
props.description: Maximum number of tags that can be selected

props.name: compact
props.description: Whether to use compact sizing (smaller typography and reduced padding)
